It cannot be compiled here: it needs the game's own Noesis.NoesisGUI.dll and other game assemblies, which are never committed. tools/tests/test_contacts_fix.py holds the DLL, the sources and the pinned hashes to this record.

pins.note: Read from source/. If any of these four does not match exactly, ContactsFix.TriggerEntryPoint logs 'inactive; original behavior retained' and patches nothing (with the owning pack disabled it logs 'inactive: owning pack is disabled'); none of the modules below installs.

noesis.is: the NoesisGUI DLL of Sea Power 0.8.7 Build 261021

module_pins.note: A module whose own pin does not match logs its own 'inactive' line and leaves the rest running.

menu_background.module: picture diagnostics off and backdrop discovery paused in missions

module_pins.timing_only: source/DiagnosticModules.cs also lists ten assemblies' hashes for its timing hooks only; a mismatch skips that assembly's timing.

settings_written.note: What the plugin changes outside its own folder. Its only file write is FormationUiMode's; the controls.ini change is written by the game itself.
settings_written.game_controls_ini: UiRefinements.AfterBindings (a postfix on InputHandler.LoadKeybindings) rebinds the game's Quick Load from F9 alone, the game's default, to LeftControl+F9; any other Quick Load binding is kept. The game's Options > Accept (OptionsMenuView.ButtonAccept_Click -> InputHandler.SaveKeybindings, read from 0.8.7's IL) writes every binding's display string to the game's controls.ini, so the move persists after the plugin, Contact Log or the pack is removed. Its log line says F9 is reserved for Contacts; nothing in this repository binds Contact Log's ToggleWindow to F9 (the owner's PC had it from the handoff's 1.3.0 installer).
settings_written.formation_ui_mode: FormationUiMode writes the Group Manager Stock UI / Enhanced UI choice to %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Triassic Games\Sea Power\SEST\formation-ui-mode-v1.txt.

toolchain: Compiled outside the repository with source/build.py: Roslyn csc run by dotnet with -langversion:9 -deterministic+ -optimize+ -nostdlib+, against NETStandard.Library.Ref 2.1.0 ref/netstandard2.1, AnchorChain.Reference.cs compiled as AnchorChain.dll, and the game's own 0Harmony, BepInEx, Noesis.NoesisGUI, Seapower-Scripts, UnityEngine.CoreModule, UnityEngine.IMGUIModule and UnityEngine.InputLegacyModule. The Roslyn and .NET SDK versions were not recorded, so a rebuild may not reproduce these bytes; with the same compiler and references it should (-deterministic+). Mono mcs cannot compile the plugin here: it stops on the missing Noesis types.
validation: In this repository (27 Oct 2026) the five pure-logic suites compile with Mono mcs 6.8.0.105 and pass 45 / 112 / 3768 / 41 / 12 checks (InputPolicy, FormationMode, PerformancePolicy, UiRefinement, StutterPolicy); tools/tests/test_contacts_fix.py reruns them when Mono is available. Not runnable here: CatalogueRuntimeTests (needs 0Harmony and dotnet) and verify_capture.py's capture checks. On the owner's PC, per the 27 Oct 2026 handoff (not reproduced here): Space and plus/minus change time without toggling Contacts, Contacts pop-out and return work, Formation Manager has its Stock UI / Enhanced UI controls, and the 1.4.2 capture shows the cost cache reused; a crash that day is unresolved, its cause unknown.
